read: Zech-only canonical and received English witnesses

authority_guards.evidence_only: Hebrew syntax, discourse, formulae, Masoretic layout, witnesses, versions, formatting, and canonical echoes are evidence only; they decide no reading, translation, speaker, referent, identity, chronology, historicity, fulfillment, authorship, canon, theology, ethics, or eschatological system.
authority_guards.lexical: Roots are not meanings; lemma numbers are not lexical authority; phrase/clause/discourse/book context controls.
authority_guards.textual: MT, LXX, DSS where extant, Syriac, Vulgate, and Targum expose pressure but select no text or emendation.
authority_guards.structure: Chapter, verse, section, accent, heading, and lineation are evidence, not authority.
authority_guards.confidence_policy: All seams LOW and deferred; disputed seams retain the larger parent.
authority_guards.promotion: One correlated candidate voice; not gold, output, graph, retrieval, or vector truth.

witness_pressure_guard.mt: OSHB and UXLC are correlated Leningrad-family evidence, not independent votes.
witness_pressure_guard.dss: 4Q80/4QXIIe fragmentarily covers portions of Zech 1:4-6,9-10,13-14; 2:6-10; 3:2-10; 4:1-2,4; 5:8-11; 6:1-3,5; 8:2-4,6-7; 12:7-12. 4Q76/4QXIIa preserves 14:18. Extent/reconstruction are evidence only.
witness_pressure_guard.lxx: Old Greek pressure is material at 4:6b-10a, 5:3, 5:6, 7:2, 9:15-17, 11:7-13, 12:10, 14:5-6; translation technique and Vorlage remain distinct.
witness_pressure_guard.syriac: Peshitta pressure includes 5:6 iniquity, 11:13 treasury, 14:6 cold/ice; no automatic reconstruction.
witness_pressure_guard.vulgate: Early construal evidence at 12:10 and 14:5-6 only.
witness_pressure_guard.targum: Paraphrastic pressure, especially 11:13 and 14:5, is reception/translation evidence only.
